# اِسْتَنْكَحْتَ (istankaḥta) /is.tan.kaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
# اِسْتَنْكَحْتِ (istankaḥti) /is.tan.kaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
# اِسْتَنْكَحَتْ (istankaḥat) /is.t
